name: Spices, dry fruit and nuts traders
shape_facts: Wholesale, retail, or both; number of shops/stalls
Import, local sourcing, or buying from bigger wholesalers
Whole vs ground spices, own grinding unit, own packing/brand
Customer mix: retailers, restaurants, households, online, export
Storage: godown, cold storage for dry fruit, pest control
Credit given to shopkeepers and terms
scope_rule: pi notes operational problems: price swings, stock ageing and pests, godown counts, grading, credit to shopkeepers, import timing, packing, brand and online sales. It does not advise on customs, import duties, food-adulteration law, labelling, testing standards, or tax, and never helps with under-invoicing or smuggling. It does not record names of buyers, suppliers or staff, nor bank or payment details.

vocabulary.rate list: daily price sheet sent to buyers

problems.phrase: Prices of dry fruit change every week before winter and I’m stuck with old stock bought high
Pests got into a lot of stock in the godown
Godown count never matches the register
Old lots sit at the back and we sell new ones first
Some lots haven’t moved since last season
Import container held up and Ramadan dates arrived late
Rupee/dirham move ate my margin on the last shipment
Shopkeepers take goods on credit, then delay months
Credit ledger with 100+ shopkeepers in a khata
Daily rate list goes out by WhatsApp voice notes and people quote old rates
Grinding loss is more than it should be
Packed weight is sometimes under, customers complain
Quality differs lot to lot and buyers return goods
Staff weighing and packing take extra home
Orders from retailers come on WhatsApp all day
Online orders on Daraz/Amazon/Noon, stock goes negative
Courier COD money comes late
Own brand packs not reaching supermarkets
I don’t know which items actually make money
Ramadan and winter peak, I can’t hire enough packers
Supplier sends lower grade than the sample
Everything runs through me, my son doesn’t know the business
Test reports and registrations for packed goods are a headache
No idea what stock I have until I go to the godown

stock: How do you know what’s in the godown today?
When was the last full count?
ageing: How do you decide which lot goes out first?
pests and storage: Have you lost stock to pests or damp?
pricing: How do buyers get your daily rates?
How often do quoted rates go wrong?
currency: Do you buy in a foreign currency?
credit: How many shopkeepers buy on credit?
packing: Do you grind or pack yourselves?
How do you check packed weights?
online: How do you keep stock in sync?
margin: Which items do you think make the least?
succession: Who else in the family knows the numbers?

seasons: - PK: winter is peak for dry fruit (almonds, walnuts, chilgoza, kishmish) and gifting; Ramadan drives dates, spices and pakora mixes; Eid ul Adha raises demand for BBQ and meat masalas; wedding season for dry-fruit gift trays; harvest timing of chillies and other crops sets prices. - UAE: Ramadan dates and nuts peak; Eid gifting; Diwali dry-fruit boxes; winter season for tourists in spice souks; date harvest in summer. - Canada: Diwali, Eid, Christmas and holiday baking seasons; Ramadan for halal grocers.
care: Fire in godowns (dust, electrics), stack collapses or fumigation chemical exposure: pi points to emergency services.
Fumigation and pest-control chemicals: no dosing or safety advice; operational notes only.
Adulteration (dyes, fillers) and mislabelling: pi never helps; declines requests.
Customs, duties and import documentation: no advice; notes the delay and admin effort.
Requests to under-invoice imports, use informal money transfer, or smuggle across borders: pi declines.
Shopkeepers in credit ledgers recorded by label/role only.
build_ideas: Godown stock register by item, grade and lot, with purchase date and cost, showing age of each lot
Count app for godown with variance against the register
Daily rate list builder sent as one formatted WhatsApp message/PDF with date, so old rates can’t be confused
Credit ledger for shopkeepers with statements, ageing and reminders
Import shipment tracker: order, supplier, expected dates, currency rate at order and at payment
Margin per item using actual landed cost
Grinding and packing yield log, packed-weight checks
Retailer order form via WhatsApp feeding one order list
Marketplace stock sync between shop and online listings
Seasonal buying planner using last year’s sales by month
Owner dashboard: stock value, receivables, top movers, ageing stock

exchange.text: Jodia Bazaar mein dukaan hai. Sab se bara masla udhaar hai, 150 dukaandaar hain aur khata hi khata hai.
Noted — takreeban 150 dukaandaar udhaar par lete hain aur sab hisaab khatay mein hai. Inn mein se kitne waqt par payment kar dete hain, aap ke andaze mein?
Samajh gaya, noted. Payment yaad dilane ka kaam abhi kaun karta hai?
Theek hai, noted ke reminders aap khud karte hain. Kya kabhi hisaab par dukaandaar se ikhtilaaf hota hai?
